votes.sql:
-- NOTE: This database schema does not contain medication or dosage tables.
-- The following query demonstrates patient distribution by age range for female patients
-- with SLE diagnosis, as medication data is unavailable in this schema.

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 30 THEN 'Under 30'
        WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 30 AND 50 THEN '30-50'
        ELSE 'Over 50'
    END AS AgeRange,
    COUNT(*) AS PatientCount
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
AND (Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' OR Diagnosis LIKE '%autoimmune%')
GROUP BY AgeRange;

SELECT AVG(julianday(discharge) - julianday(admission)) AS avg_stay
FROM (
    SELECT p.ID,
           p."First Date" AS admission,
           (
               SELECT MAX(d) FROM (
                   SELECT e."Examination Date" AS d FROM Examination e WHERE e.ID = p.ID
                   UNION ALL
                   SELECT l.Date AS d FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID = p.ID
               )
           ) AS discharge
    FROM Patient p
    WHERE p.Admission = '+'
      AND p."First Date" IS NOT NULL
) sub
WHERE discharge IS NOT NULL;
